criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.rationale: First two lines run roughly 186 characters, inside the ~210 cutoff, and stand alone with a specific noun, verb and stake. Held back from 10 because the instrument is only named in verb form above the fold.

criteria.name: Mechanism load-bearing + AK consequence
criteria.rationale: Sector named, actors named (AEA with Curtis Thayer on record, Homer Electric at Bernice Lake, Kenai Peninsula Borough, area tribes), consequence is a specific legal disability. AI tie documentary, not decorative. Short of 10 because the timeframe stays relative and the 1,650-acre corridor figure was cut.

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.rationale: Five layers, all in dossier, all actors matching, causal order preserved. The Layer 5 loop-back makes the concentration of authority visible. One deduction for compressing Layer 1's actor to 'the applicant'.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.rationale: One layer, one office, one binary, both branches with consequences attached. Liveness sourced to Celeste Miller. Held to 9 because the paragraph says 'FERC's Northwest Branch' while the dossier's decider is the Director, OEP, named only in the bullet block.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.rationale: Takes a real position grounded in the machinery, proportionate and fair to the applicant. Bradley Lake contrast drawn explicitly and does real work. Short of 10 because the sharpest dossier formulation is compressed into the single word 'standing'.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.rationale: Concrete and actionable with a real trigger, well above 'watch this space', but the thinnest block. No date in the forward paragraph itself despite the post owning two clocks, and it does not close who is positioned versus who is not.

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.rationale: All five layers trace to primary text, four to CFR and statute, Layer 4 to the FERC notice itself. Chokepoint citation is primary. Held at 9 because the applied instance (18 June letter, pending status) rests solely on ADN, handled honestly by attribution.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.rationale: Alaska-first, analytical, position-taking, no banned phrases. Best moments are post_001-grade. One sustained drift: clipped and citation-dense under word-cap pressure, with bullets reading as telegraphic comma-chains rather than plain-language breakdown.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.rationale: Both windows met, bullet block at max 5 items, most paragraphs 2 to 4 sentences. The chokepoint paragraph runs seven or eight sentences and is the densest block, and bullet items are not clean single clauses.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.rationale: Genuinely debatable, addressed to the audience holding the decision, tied to the chokepoint specifically via 'after that letter goes out'. No CTA, no rhetorical softener, proposes a real strategic alternative.
